tasks.label: E1-1: Verify Ubuntu Remote Workspace
args:
set -Eeuo pipefail; . /etc/os-release; printf 'OS=%s
' "$PRETTY_NAME"; printf 'SHELL=%s
' "$SHELL"; printf 'PROCESS=%s
' "$(ps -p $$ -o comm= | xargs)"; printf 'PWD=%s
' "$PWD"; printf 'GIT_ROOT=%s
' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; printf 'BRANCH=%s
' "$(git branch --show-current)"; test "${VERSION_ID:-}" = '24.04'; test "$(ps -p $$ -o comm= | xargs)" = 'bash'; test "$PWD" = "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; echo '[PASS] Ubuntu 24.04, bash, workspace folder and Git root verified.'
